items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: he took me under his wing and I learned more from him

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And so I joined Helvey's band and our headquarters was Cincinnati. Then I run into a trombone player, Floyd Brady. We called him Little Stump, and he took me under his wing and I learned more from him --
By the way, he's still living, isn't he?
